title: Perfect direct image of a tensor product with proper support
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes of finite presentation [def-pc-morphism-conventions]. Let $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ be perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex], and let $\mathcal G^\bullet$ be a bounded complex of finitely presented $\mathcal O_X$-modules, each flat over $S$, whose terms have support proper over $S$ [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base]. Then $$K=Rf_*(E\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal G^\bullet)$$ is perfect in $D(\mathcal O_S)$, and its formation commutes with arbitrary base change: for every $g:T\to S$, the canonical map $Lg^*K\to Rf_{T,*}(E_T\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_{X_T}}\mathcal G_T^\bullet)$ is an isomorphism.
